# CastorPollux — credits and source notices

CastorPollux is a Windows desktop interface and packaging layer for local binary analysis. It combines the following third-party projects; their names and trademarks remain with their respective owners. The source links below are also available in the application's Credits screen.

The Castor and Pollux Gemini artwork was generated specifically for this application and is included as `castorpollux-gemini.png` and `CastorPollux.ico`.

| Component | Purpose | Source | License / notice |
|---|---|---|---|
| REA (`rea-agents` 6.5.0) | Analysis evidence CLI | [morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea) | MIT; bundled dependency notices in `REA-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` |
| Ghidra 12.1.4 | Import, disassembly, decompilation, project export | [NSA Ghidra](https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra) | Apache 2.0; `Ghidra-NOTICE.txt` and additional licenses are supplied with the package |
| Eclipse Temurin JDK 21 | Java runtime for Ghidra | [Eclipse Adoptium](https://adoptium.net/) | GPLv2 with Classpath Exception; bundled notice |
| Node.js 24 | JavaScript runtime for REA | [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) | Node.js license and third-party notices |
| pnpm 11 | Installs REA updates and dependencies | [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/) | MIT |
| CustomTkinter 6 | Desktop GUI controls | [CustomTkinter](https://github.com/TomSchimansky/CustomTkinter) | MIT |
| darkdetect | Theme detection used by CustomTkinter | [darkdetect](https://github.com/albertosottile/darkdetect) | BSD 3-Clause |
| packaging | Version comparison for updates | [Python Packaging Authority](https://github.com/pypa/packaging) | Apache 2.0 or BSD 2-Clause |
| Python 3.12 | Application runtime | [Python](https://www.python.org/) | PSF and included notices |
| PyInstaller 6 | Self-extracting EXE bootloader | [PyInstaller](https://pyinstaller.org/) | GPL with special exception for distributing bundled applications |
| ReportLab 4 | PDF report generation | [ReportLab](https://www.reportlab.com/) | BSD-style license |
| Pillow | Image support used by ReportLab | [Pillow](https://python-pillow.github.io/) | MIT-CMU |
| charset-normalizer | Text encoding support used by ReportLab | [charset-normalizer](https://github.com/jawah/charset_normalizer) | MIT |
| Codex CLI (optional, not bundled) | Opt-in security review of saved findings | [OpenAI Codex](https://developers.openai.com/codex) | Separate installation and account access |
| Claude Code CLI (optional, not bundled) | Opt-in review of saved findings | [Anthropic Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference) | Separate installation and account access |
| OpenCode CLI (optional, not bundled) | Opt-in review of saved findings | [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/) | Separate installation and provider account access |
| Ollama (optional, not bundled) | Local model server for offline review | [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) | Separate installation and downloaded model; see the model's own license |
| RetDec (optional, not bundled) | Independent decompiler comparison for high-severity findings | [Avast RetDec](https://github.com/avast/retdec) | Separate installation; see its own license |
| Windows Sandbox (optional, not bundled) | Isolated runtime telemetry (untested in this build) | [Microsoft Windows Sandbox](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/security/application-security/application-isolation/windows-sandbox/windows-sandbox-configure-using-wsb-file) | Windows feature; availability depends on the host edition and configuration |

CWE labels and descriptions are based on the [MITRE CWE catalog](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/index.html); CastorPollux produces narrow candidate mappings from saved pseudocode and does not claim MITRE endorsement. Online PDB lookup follows [Microsoft's symbol store documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/debug/using-symsrv). ELF debuginfo lookup follows the [elfutils debuginfod interface](https://sourceware.org/elfutils/Debuginfod.html). These references are documentation, not bundled components.

Opt-in known-vulnerability leads use the [NIST National Vulnerability Database CVE API](https://nvd.nist.gov/developers/vulnerabilities). NVD data is an external advisory source, not a bundled engine or a confirmation that a particular binary is vulnerable. NIST does not endorse CastorPollux.

License texts supplied with this distribution are in `CastorPollux-Licenses/`. The packaged EXE also carries upstream runtime files and their notices. Additional licenses from Ghidra and REA dependencies remain in their bundled folders and packages.

Analysis results are generated by Ghidra and REA. REA's Windows Ghidra provider is described upstream as experimental and read-only. See [the REA Windows Ghidra notes](https://github.com/morluto/rea/blob/main/docs/windows-ghidra-p0.md).

The Windows Sandbox execution feature is untested in this build. A commercial distribution audit and full shipped-component license inventory are included in the release package.
